pick.headline: UN Resolution 661 imposes sanctions on Iraq
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of August 8, 1990, carried Moscow TASS in English on Perez de Cuellar circulating Resolution 661's sanctions against Iraq to all member states, recalling the Rhodesia and South Africa precedents, and a Kuwaiti message on Iraqi mistreatment of civilians.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 153, 8 August 1990
evidence.snippet: …90 Moscow TASS in English 0748 GMT 8 Aug 90 [By TASS correspondent Mikhail Kochetkov] [Text] United Nations August 8 TASS—UN Secretary- General Javier Perez de Cuellar has sent the text of UN Security Council Resolution 661 on sanctions against Iraq to all 159 international community member- countries.
